title: The King's Son and the Desert Mirage
summary: The Seventh Vizier concluded the defense of the prince with a tale of vigilance:
keywords: the king's son and the ogress
full_text:
The Seventh Vizier concluded the defense of the prince with a tale of vigilance:

'A young prince, lost in the trackless sands of the desert, came upon an enchanting oasis with crystal fountains, date palms heavy with fruit, and a golden pavilion where a veiled lady invited him to rest.

Exhausted by the desert heat, the prince was about to enter the pavilion when he noticed that neither the palm trees nor the lady cast a shadow upon the burning sand!

Remembering his father’s teachings that evil spirits cannot produce a natural shadow in the sunlight, the prince halted upon the threshold. He drew his hunting dagger, inscribed words of divine protection in the sand, and refused to enter.

The moment the sacred words were spoken, the golden pavilion, the crystal fountains, and the lovely lady vanished like mist, leaving only a barren salt flat and a venomous desert viper slithering into the rocks!

The prince bowed his head in humble thanksgiving, learning that a watchful mind and adherence to ancestral wisdom pierce the most glittering mirages of the world.'

Hearing these seven days of wisdom, the King embraced his innocent son, dismissed the false accusers, and ruled his realm in equity, proving that patience and wise counsel are the true pillars of justice.
moral: Patience and steadfast adherence to moral duty dispel the most seductive illusions of danger.
